messages:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v3.5.0 -> 20% (split: eu-central 50%, eu-west 50%). warming 1 pod/az. notes: docs/release/3.5.0.md :party_popper:
nina-rel: seeing a small but sharp spike in 5xx in eu-central around 09:40 UTC. rate went from 0.2% -> 1.1% in 5m. nothing yet in eu-west. :warning:
tobias-eng: which API surface? any common denominator?
ops-jen: could be downstream auth cache invalidation. I rolled a routing tweak earlier today that affects session affinity.
nina-rel: stack snippet: ```2026-03-24T09:41:03Z ERROR http 502 upstream_timeout service=auth-proxy shard=7 model=v2-quant```
maya-pm: we have a customer demo in 45m (EU region). need a recommendation in ~10m.
qa-bot: smoke: all quick-checks passed pre-rollout. no regressions on canary tests.
tobias-eng: looks like shard=7 quant variant hitting a load path that times out under an auth cache miss. hypothesis: cache-priming failure when mixed quant/non-quant replicas receive new requests.
ops-jen: option A: PAUSE eu-central rollout and pin region to v3.4.9 (last known good). cmd: `deploybot pin --region eu-central --version v3.4.9 --note "5xx spike"`
ops-jen: option B: THROTTLE to 5% globally and add a temporary route to prefer non-quant replicas for auth endpoints in eu-central. less disruptive but more fiddly.
tobias-eng: prefer pin for eu-central to limit blast radius. can investigate quant load path without live customer risk.
nina-rel: +1 pin. p95 not bad but 5xx looks user-facing.
maya-pm: pin accepted. I'll pause the demo timer and notify stakeholders.
deploy-bot: acknowledged. ready to apply pin upon command.
ops-jen: executing: `deploybot pin --region eu-central --version v3.4.9 --reason "5xx auth spike"` — running now.
deploy-bot: pin applied for eu-central -> v3.4.9. traffic in eu-central cutover to pinned version. continuing rollout in eu-west at 20% but adding HOLD at 10% if any error metric crosses threshold. Next check in 10m. :hourglass:
tobias-eng: I'm spinning up instrumented replicas for shard=7 to reproduce cache warmup. will post logs if I hit the issue.
qa-bot: scheduled focused regression run for auth flow in eu-central; will report in 6m.
nina-rel: thanks. decision: STOP/REVERT in eu-central (via pin to v3.4.9). no full rollback; containment via region pin. reconvene on thread in 10m. :white_check_mark:
